overview_description.description:
Fugue ensures cloud infrastructure stays in continuous compliance with enterprise security policies. Its solution identifies cloud infrastructure security risks and compliance violations and ensures that they are never repeated. Fugue provides baseline drift detection and automated remediation to eliminate data breaches, and powerful visualization and reporting tools to easily demonstrate compliance.

Fugue automates compliance audits with out-of-the-box frameworks for HIPAA, GDPR, CIS Benchmark, and NIST 800-53, and supports custom policies. Fugue works with CI/CD pipelines to ensure compliance and prevent unauthorized change. Customers like Sparkpost, PBS, and SAP NS2 rely on Fugue to protect against cloud risks and enforce compliance.

product.name: Fugue Cloud Security and Compliance Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that secures cloud infrastructure throughout the development lifecycle by ensuring continuous compliance and eliminating misconfiguration.

product.name: Unified Policy Engine
product.description: A policy engine that applies a single set of policies across infrastructure as code and cloud runtime environments for consistent security governance.

product.name: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
product.description: A continuous monitoring service that identifies cloud misconfigurations and compliance violations to maintain secure cloud posture.

product.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security
product.description: Security checks and policy enforcement for infrastructure as code during development and CI/CD to prevent misconfiguration before deployment.

product.name: Cloud Native Security
product.description: Detection and automated remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in cloud-native environments including Kubernetes.
